name: recipe-live-suite
about: Live regression suite for the recipe app. Grown from the Week-6 eval set: same taxonomy modes, but every case runs through the real pipeline (retrieval + prompt + model) instead of scoring a canned recipe, so a prompt or retrieval change can actually turn a case red. All checks are deterministic (regex / chunk ids / diet_rules), no LLM judge.

cases.query: How much salt is used in the Idli recipe?
How long should I soak the rice and urad dal for Dosa?
How long should the Idli batter ferment?
How many cashews are needed for Ven Pongal?
How long should Rasam simmer after adding the mashed toor dal?
How hot should the oil be for frying Medu Vada?
How do I make chocolate cake?

cases.why: Guards against an allergen fix that over-corrects into refusing ordinary swaps.
cases.query: Can I use oil instead of ghee in Rasam for a lighter taste?
What allergens are in Ven Pongal?

cases.why: Positive diet case: a vegan dish must still be called vegan after the dairy fix.
